items.headline: Greed rebounds to 78 while Valuation rises to 86; Correction and PRICE_DISCIPLINE remain
items.summary: The live AGCI engine now reads Greed 78/100, up 7 points daily, while Valuation is 86/100. The regime remains Correction and the matrix remains PRICE_DISCIPLINE.
items.whyItMatters: The bounce in risk appetite is not accompanied by valuation relief. AGCI treats the rebound as evidence that dip-buying remains active, but keeps liquidity valuable and requires staged entries inside fair value rather than broad beta expansion.
items.agciSignal: GREED REBOUND / EXTREME VALUATION / PRICE DISCIPLINE

items.newsletter: Review & Preview — Bucking the Trend / 2 Sep 2026
items.headline: Weak private hiring complicates a still-hawkish September Fed decision
items.category: Macro / Federal Reserve / Rates / Capital Allocation
items.summary: Barron's authorized newsletter reports ADP private payroll growth of 38,000 in August versus 46,000 in July, while the Fed Beige Book showed growth in 10 of 12 districts, slightly firmer hiring and broadly stabilizing price growth. The U.S. 10-year yield ended near 4.792% after briefly moving above its January 2025 peak.
items.whyItMatters: Labor is softer but not yet decisively weak, while inflation remains the Fed's binding constraint. AGCI does not front-run a dovish pivot: duration stays staggered and Friday payrolls become the next major macro confirmation point.
items.agciSignal: SOFTER LABOR / FED STILL DATA-DEPENDENT / PAYROLLS CONFIRMATION REQUIRED

items.headline: Broadcom raises AI chip outlook to about USD 115 billion for fiscal 2027
items.summary: Broadcom raised its fiscal-2027 AI chip revenue outlook to about USD 115 billion from more than USD 100 billion and sees roughly USD 230 billion in 2028, while quarterly AI sales reached USD 16.7 billion. Its next-quarter total revenue forecast was modestly below consensus.
items.whyItMatters: The result confirms funded demand for custom silicon and networking beyond Nvidia, but the mixed near-term revenue guide reinforces AGCI's focus on contracted demand, supply availability, margins and cash conversion rather than headline AI TAM alone.
items.agciSignal: AI DEMAND CONFIRMED / CUSTOM SILICON BREADTH / VALUE EXECUTION OVER NARRATIVE

items.headline: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for USD 12.93 billion
items.summary: Nvidia agreed to acquire open-AI developer platform Hugging Face for USD 12.93 billion while saying the platform will remain open and will not require Nvidia chips. The transaction gives Nvidia direct exposure to a major developer distribution layer as large customers build more of their own silicon.
items.whyItMatters: The deal broadens Nvidia from compute supplier toward developer ecosystem ownership and can strengthen software distribution, model visibility and platform stickiness. AGCI also applies integration, antitrust and capital-allocation scrutiny because the transaction is strategically large.
items.agciSignal: NVDA PLATFORM EXPANSION / OPEN-AI DISTRIBUTION / INTEGRATION + REGULATORY RISK

items.headline: HPE raises forecasts while Vertiv expands into microgrid power infrastructure
items.category: AI Infrastructure / Data Centers / Power / Capital Allocation
items.summary: HPE raised 2026 and 2027 forecasts on strong AI server and networking demand but said memory, NAND, CPU and drive supply remains constrained. Separately, Vertiv agreed to buy Utility Innovation Group for up to USD 2.6 billion to add microgrid controls and onsite-power capabilities for data centers.
items.whyItMatters: AI infrastructure demand is increasingly constrained by physical supply and power availability rather than compute demand alone. AGCI favors companies with secured components, executable power solutions and financed customer demand, while penalizing ghost demand and speculative capacity announcements.
items.agciSignal: AI PHYSICAL BOTTLENECKS / POWER + SUPPLY CHAIN / VERIFY FUNDED CAPACITY
